title: Google launches 15 free AI tools for marketing, design #googleai #aitoolslaunch #digitalinnovation
description: Google released 15 free AI tools designed to transform marketing, design, coding, and image creation. Among these tools are Gemini for automated social media content, Stitch for UI design from text prompts, Google Opal for AI-powered workflow automation, Antigravity as a code editor, and Mixport for generating and refining AI images. These tools leverage Google’s advanced AI models to streamline digital workflows, saving time and reducing costs for businesses and creators. They represent a significant step in making powerful AI capabilities accessible without expensive software subscriptions. The availability of these tools supports innovation across sectors such as marketing, software development, and creative design, enabling users to increase productivity and creativity with minimal technical expertise. #GoogleAI #GeminiAI #GoogleOpal #AntigravityAI #Mixport #AItools #ArtificialIntelligence #UIDesign #WorkflowAutomation #AICodeEditor #AIDesign #CreativeAI #TechInnovation #FreeAITools
